summary_en: Presents SonarReg-GS SLAM, a visual-acoustic underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM system in which object-conditioned forward-looking-sonar returns are filtered into sparse metric depth anchors. These anchors regularize monocular depth before Gaussian initialization, tracking, and mapping, while an object-aware RGB mask loss strengthens local supervision. Experiments on the UXO and OPTI RGB-sonar datasets report improved trajectory accuracy and rendering quality over classical and Gaussian-SLAM baselines.
